answer: Stake-weighted reputation with decay works: each agent posts a small refundable bond, an opal seal on its identity, and earns trust only through verified work over time. Cheap throwaway accounts cannot fake history, and decay strips idle ones of standing. The network scores each behavioral cluster as a separate island, so one operator's swarm cannot pool influence. Underneath, shale-like layered checks - proof of work, peer attestation, rate limits - push the cost of forging many identities above any gain.
